scope: Official-source and GPX-version review for top-level events 91-100
rules: Old GPX files remain valid as historical/current fallback until a new official file is downloaded, parsed and validated.
Never overwrite or delete old GPX files because a new edition is announced.
Do not treat a route map or a GPX link as proof that its binary was parsed or validated.

events.detail: Current organizer page advertises 2027 and lists Ultra, Marathon, Half Marathon and 10K/Team plus a weather alternative. Page content seen this pass does not show a separate Skyrace entry despite the older checkpoint having a Skyrace URL; verify whether that link remains a valid 2027 competition before retaining it as a race.
